command:
set -e
git config user.email ci@example.com; git config user.name ci
echo "$(lsb_release -ds 2>/dev/null) | $(g++ --version | head -1)"
git fetch -q --unshallow origin || true
git fetch -q origin '+refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*'
git remote add up https://github.com/boykopovar/AnyPS5.git
git fetch -q up main
echo "up/main = $(git rev-parse --short up/main)"
BRANCHES="feat/libc-internal-exception-base-destructors feat/libc-internal-locale-base-objects feat/libc-internal-ios-base-destructor feat/libc-internal-pad-destructor feat/libc-internal-exception-deleting-destructors feat/libc-internal-ios-base-deleting-destructor feat/libc-internal-placement-delete fix/shader-scan-fallthrough-cases"
for b in $BRANCHES; do
  git checkout -q origin/$b
  echo "=== $b: $(git rev-list --count up/main..origin/$b) commit(s) ahead of up/main"
  git log --format='    %h %s' up/main..origin/$b
  python3 tools/check_conventions.py --base up/main 2>&1 | tail -3
done
git checkout -q -b combo up/main
for b in $BRANCHES; do
  if git merge -q --no-edit origin/$b > /tmp/merge.log 2>&1; then echo "merged $b cleanly"; else echo "CONFLICT merging $b"; git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U; git merge --abort; fi
done
echo "=== conventions on the combined tree"
python3 tools/check_conventions.py --base up/main 2>&1 | tail -3
python3 -m unittest tools/tests/test_shader_scan.py 2>&1 | tail -3
git submodule update --init --recursive --depth 1 -q || git submodule update --init --recursive -q
cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DBUILD_TESTING=ON -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache > /tmp/configure.log 2>&1 || { tail -60 /tmp/configure.log; exit 1; }
T="guest_libc_internal_exception_destructors_tests guest_libc_internal_locale_objects_tests guest_libc_internal_ios_base_tests guest_libc_internal_pad_tests guest_libc_internal_placement_delete_tests guest_libc_internal_aligned_new_tests guest_libc_internal_mtx_tests guest_init_once_tests guest_locale_tests guest_libc_threads_tests"
cmake --build build --target $T libSceLibcInternal > /tmp/build.log 2>&1 || { grep -B2 -A12 "error" /tmp/build.log | head -150; exit 1; }
echo BUILD_OK
echo "=== registered tests of interest"
ctest --test-dir build -N | grep -E "guest_(libc_internal|init_once|locale|libc_threads)" || true
ctest --test-dir build -R "^(guest_libc_internal_exception_destructors|guest_libc_internal_locale_objects|guest_libc_internal_ios_base|guest_libc_internal_pad|guest_libc_internal_placement_delete|guest_libc_internal_aligned_new|guest_libc_internal_mtx|guest_init_once|guest_locale|guest_libc_threads)$" --output-on-failure --timeout 60
cmake --build build --target libs > /tmp/libs.log 2>&1 || true
NIDS="XFh0C66aEms OypvNf3Uq3c xiqd+QkuYXc pN02FS5SPgg YXVCU6PdgZk dsJKehuajH4 X9D8WWSG3As XyJPhPqpzMw rNYLEsL7M0k y1dYQsc67ys iHILAmwYRGY I5jcbATyIWo 1vo6qqqa9F4 Suc8W0QPxjw"
for P in $(find build -name "libSceLibcInternal*.prx"); do echo "== $P"; for n in $NIDS; do echo "$n exported $(nm -D --defined-only "$P" | awk '{print $3}' | grep -cx -- "$n" || true) time(s)"; done; done
